def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==2]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    # find aligned pairs (share row or col), prefer longer span
    best=None
    for (i1,j1),(i2,j2) in itertools.combinations(pts,2):
        if i1==i2: d=max(j1,j2)-min(j1,j2)+1
        elif j1==j2: d=max(i1,i2)-min(i1,i2)+1
        else: continue
        if best is None or d>best[0]: best=(d,(i1,j1,i2,j2))
    d,(a,b,c,dp)=best
    lo,hi=min(a,b),max(a,b)
    for k in range(lo,hi+1): O[a][k]=3
    line=set((a,k) for k in range(lo,hi+1))
    def dist(p):
        i,j=p
        return min(abs(i-l)+abs(j-k) for l,k in line)
    unp=[p for p in pts if p not in ((a,lo),(a,hi))]
    for p in unp:
        i,j=p
        cand=[]
        if any(k in range(lo,hi+1) for k in [j]):  # can attach vertically
            pass
        # attach straight toward line: either vertical drop to row a at col j (if within span) or horizontal to nearest line col
        v_ok = lo<=j<=hi
        horiz = min(abs(j-k) for k in range(W) if (a,k) in line)
        vert = abs(i-a) if v_ok else 99
        path=[]
        if vert<=horiz:
            for r_ in range(i,a+1 if i<a else a-1,-(a-i)and 1 or -(a-i)):
                pass
            rr=range(i,a) if i<a else range(i+1,a+1)
            for r_ in rr: path.append((r_,j))
        else:
            cc=min(range(W), key=lambda k: abs(j-k))
            for c_ in range(j,cc) if j<cc else range(j+1,cc+1): path.append((i,c_))
        for x,y in path: O[x][y]=3
    return O
import itertools

for r in out: print(r)
